name: Squid simmered with tamarind
summary: Mực rim me is a gift at chợ Hạ Long 1 and chợ Hạ Long 2. Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, lists it with fresh chả mực, ruốc tôm, and mực một nắng as what you carry home from those markets.
origin: Hạ Long markets, on the 6 May 2020 account. A cooking method beyond the name was not printed.
howToEat: Buy it to take home. A recipe was not printed.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Hạ Long 1 on đường Bạch Đằng and chợ Hạ Long 2 on đường Lê Lợi, about 1 km apart, on the 6 May 2020 account.
